verdict.rationale: Devin is delivered as a cloud-hosted SaaS agent platform; all evidence points to cloud sessions, API access, VPN connectivity into customer networks, and a CLI/terminal client for local interaction, but nothing indicates the core agent infrastructure itself can be self-hosted on-prem, in customer-managed containers, or on customer VMs. Missing for 10: any documentation of a self-hosted/on-prem deployment option, container images for the agent runtime, or VM-based installation of Devin's backend.
